item.title: Man who killed pregnant Seattle woman found not guilty by reason of insanity
item.description: The suspect in a 2023 random shooting in Seattle that left a mother and her unborn baby dead, and injured the woman's husband, has been found not guilty by reason of insanity.

item.title: Where is Jonathan Hoang? WA man with autism disappeared 1 year ago
item.description: Monday marks one year since Jonathan Hoang disappeared. The 21-year-old has a developmental disability and vanished from his Arlington home on March 30, 2025.

item.title: Police say WA man shoots kid in the chest for throwing a water balloon
item.description: What began as a teenage prank ended in a near-fatal shooting and a $150,000 bail for a 31-year-old Tacoma man.

item.title: As fuel prices rise, WA farmers face mounting challenges
item.description: Rising fuel prices are squeezing farmers across Washington state. At a farm in Arlington, Andrew Albert said the timing could not be worse.

item.title: SCOTUS hears case that could impact WA ballot counting
item.description: The Supreme Court's conservative majority on Monday sounded skeptical of state laws that allow the counting of late-arriving mail ballots. Washington is one of those states.

item.title: Seattle high-rises connected by decommissioned Boeing 747 fuselage
item.description: It's been called a tribute to Seattle's innovation in aviation, as a Boeing jet now connects two towers as part of the development underway in the South Lake Union neighborhood.

item.title: Seattle Kraken acquire majority stake in Climate Pledge Arena, launch One Roof Sports & Entertainment
item.description: The ownership of the Seattle Kraken announced the creation of One Roof Sports and Entertainment on Monday, an umbrella corporation that will oversee the group's current sports portfolio with an eye toward a possible bid for an NBA expansion franchise.

item.title: WA man booked into jail for 98th time after high-speed chase in Olympia
item.description: Thurston County deputies arrested a pair of organized retail theft suspects following a high-speed pursuit on I-5 in Olympia.

item.title: Covington community honors fallen Air Force captain
item.description: The Covington community came together Monday night to remember Air Force Captain Ariana Savino, one of six service members killed in a plane crash in Iraq.

item.title: Seattle weather: Wet start to Tuesday with breezy winds
item.description: A wet start to the day Tuesday with widespread showers and snow in the higher elevations.
